units.title: Mining History
topics: 1.1. Ancient history & origin of mining and its need.
1.2. Different civilization and their approach towards mining.
uos: 1.b. Describe need and importance of mining.
1.c. List different approach in Mining industry.

units.title: Mining Termino- logy
topics: 2.1. Define- Mine, Mining, Ore, rock, Mineral, Gangue, gangue mineral Coal, Bed, Strata, Deposits-Vein deposit, Stratified deposit, massive deposit. &outcrop deposits
2.2. Open cast mining terminology- Overburden rock, mineral bed, top soil, stripping ratio, box-cut, bench formation, waste dump & mine sump,
2.3. Underground Mining terminology-Approach mode- (incline, shaft & adit) Level, dip, rise, strike, pillar, roof, floor, goaf, face, haulage & fan ventilation.
uos: 2.a. Explain basic terminology used for Mining.

units.title: Types & Stages of Mining
topics: 3.1. Types of Mining- Opencast Mining, Underground mining, Placer mining, In-situ leaching & High wall mining.
3.2. Stages of Mining- Prospecting, Exploration, Excavation and Reclamation & Rehabilitation.
uos: 3.d. Justify the use of Mine reclamation.

units.title: Importance of Geology
topics: 4.1. History of Geology-Origin of Earth. Theories for origin of Earth-the nebular hypothesis & the tidal hypothesis.
4.2. Benefits of geology in Mining Industry.
4.3. Role of geologist in Mining Industry. Introduction to Mining & Geology Course Code: C4312201 NITTTR Bhopal – GTU - COGC-2021 Curriculum Topics and Sub-topics
uos: 4.b. Explain need and importance of Geology.
4.c. Justify the use of geology in Mining Industry.
4.d. List the importance of geologist in mining industry.

units.title: Geological Terminology and Rocks
topics: 5.1. Geological features- Fold- anticline & syncline, fault, joints, dyke, sills.
5.2. Sedimentary rock, Igneous rock and metamorphic rock with example.
uos: 5.d. Explain formation of different types of rocks.
